question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Weired"** is incorrectly spelt and should be **"Weird"**.
 
• **"Weird"** means something that is very strange or unusual. (अजीब)
 
 
• **Example: **She had a weird feeling that she was being watched.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Until **(तब तक): Up to the point in time or the event mentioned.

 
 
• **Example:** We will wait here until the rain stops.
 
 
 
• **Vacuum **(निर्वात ): A space entirely devoid of matter.
 
 
• **Example: **The room was so quiet, it felt like a vacuum.
 
 
 
• **Separate** (अलग): To set or keep apart.
 
 
• **Example:** Please separate the recyclable items from the trash.
